responsibility: Generated GCC option-description fragment for the NVPTX backend that declares the ptx_isa enum values corresponding to supported sm_* architectures. It supplies the option table entries consumed by GCC’s option machinery for parsing -misa= values and is mechanically derived from nvptx-sm.def to keep supported ISA names synchronized.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/config/nvptx/nvptx-gen.h, this generated nvptx-gen file is an .opt option-description fragment: it declares the ptx_isa enum and EnumValue mappings for sm_* strings consumed by GCC option parsing, rather than C macros used by backend code for TARGET_SMxx tests.
